title: Indian Army Procures 10,000+ Meprolight 'MEPRO X6' Telescopic Sights for NEGEV LMGs
summary: First army in the world to place telescopic optics on light machine guns at scale.

blocks.content: First army in the world to place telescopic optics on light machine guns at scale.

items: MEPRO X6 Sight: Fixed 6x magnification daytime sight with 1,000m effective range for NEGEV NG-7 7.62x51mm LMGs.
Prime Contractor: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) secured tender via Transfer of Technology (ToT) from Israel's Meprolight & RRP Defense.
Global First: Marks 1st instance globally of a military deploying telescopic optics on LMGs across regular infantry.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: NEGEV NG-7 LMG manufactured in India under licence from Israel Weapon Industries (IWI).
